standard.summary: 启动前探测当前运行时是否真的支持所选压缩后端。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Probes before startup whether the current runtime really supports the chosen compression backend.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 启动前探测当前运行时是否真的支持所选压缩后端。建议保持开启，这样可以明确确认 qfloat8 / torchao Float8 是否真实生效，避免出现“开了预设但实际没压缩”的假象。

advanced_en.principle: Probes before launch whether the current runtime actually supports the selected compression backend. Recommended to keep on: it confirms explicitly whether qfloat8 / torchao Float8 is truly in effect, avoiding the illusion of "preset enabled but nothing actually compressed".
